official.deadline_note: All six 2026 programme calls shared one window, 5 to 18 May 2026 (17:00 Lisbon time). The 2027 call had not been published when verified on 2026-10-10, and the window shifts between cycles - most 2025 programmes ran 3 to 18 June 2025, while the 2025 online Summer Course ran 5 to 18 May 2025 - so the dates must be re-checked each year.
official.application_cycle: 2026 call - applications 5 to 18 May 2026; awards for the 2026/2027 school year (Annual Course) and from September 2026 onwards (Research, Pessoa, Vieira)
official.status_note: The 2026 calls closed on 18 May 2026 at 17:00 Lisbon time. Provisional lists were published on 25 May 2026, candidates had until 5 p.m. on 9-19 June 2026 to comment or supply missing documents, and definitive result lists were published in June 2026. The page now carries only final result lists for the 2026 round; the 2027 call had not been announced as of 2026-10-10.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording from the 2026 opening notices: 'It is the responsibility of each scholarship holder to pay the registration fee and tuition at the university where they will attend the course, as well as all travel and accommodation expenses' (Annual Course). The Research notice states 'The scholarship holder is also responsible for tuition fees and registration at the higher education institution attended' and 'Travel and accommodation costs are the responsibility of the scholarship holder'. The Vieira and Pessoa notices repeat that the holder pays 'registration fees and tuition fees at the higher education institution to be attended'. The single exception is the online Summer Course scholarship, which the 2026 Summer Course notice states 'Covers course registration/tuition fee'.
benefits: Research Programme: monthly allowance of EUR 990, to a maximum of 11 monthly payments per year (13 scholarships offered in 2026)

Vieira Programme (translation and conference interpreting): EUR 990 per month, up to a maximum of 11 monthly payments, to be defined in accordance with the contract to be signed (2 scholarships offered in 2026)
Fernao Mendes Pinto Programme: EUR 750.00 per month, up to a maximum of 11 monthly payments, as defined in the contract to be signed (18 scholarships offered in 2026)
Pessoa Programme: EUR 700.00 per month, duration varying between one and six months (1 scholarship offered in 2026)
Annual Course Programme: EUR 875 per month for an eight-month course, not renewable (14 scholarships offered in 2026)

Summer Course Programme 2026: in-person monthly stipend of EUR 1,150.00 (10 scholarships); online scholarships cover the course registration/tuition fee (58 scholarships). The Pessoa notice also states that 'Camoes, I.P. provides personal accident insurance for the scholarship holder for the duration of the scholarship.'
eligibility: Summer Course: foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad who wish to improve their language skills; in-person courses may be attended at any Portuguese university
Annual Course: foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad who wish to improve their language skills

Fernao Mendes Pinto Programme: graduates or final-year students, both foreign and Portuguese, engaged in scientific or professional training projects in the field of Portuguese as a foreign language, through Camoes, I.P. Portuguese Language Centers, Camoes, I.P. Lectureships, and foreign universities or institutions that have agreements with Camoes, I.P.

Research Programme: foreign professors and researchers, as well as Portuguese nationals residing abroad, who wish to carry out in Portugal advanced studies in Portuguese language and culture, namely Master's and PhD Programs at Portuguese universities
Pessoa Programme: heads of Portuguese Studies Chairs and Portuguese Departments at foreign universities or research institutes
Vieira Programme: foreign graduates and Portuguese nationals residing abroad who are involved in training and/or advanced development projects in the field of translation and conference interpreting
requirements: Applications must be submitted electronically via the Camoes, I.P. Services Portal (https://portalservicos.instituto-camoes.pt/); applications submitted by any other means, in person or electronically, will not be accepted
Each candidate may submit only one application per programme; otherwise all applications submitted will be cancelled
Providing false statements will result in cancellation of the application
Documents failing to meet the stated requirements will not be considered for evaluation or award
It is expressly forbidden to accumulate scholarships granted by Camoes, I.P. with any other grants of the same nature awarded by another Portuguese institution
Award of the scholarship depends on fulfilment of the requirements of the notice and receipt of all required documentation
Applicable legislation: Regulation of the Scholarship Program, approved by Order (Despatch) no. 1251/2011 of 14 January
documents: Motivation letter (100 to 400 words) explaining the reasons for applying and how the scholarship will contribute to the candidate's professional path and to the dissemination of Portuguese language and culture; for course scholarships the letter must indicate the level of proficiency conferred by the course to be attended

Two letters of recommendation issued by two people of recognized repute, preferably university professors or lecturers in the field of Portuguese; recommendation letters must be written in Portuguese or English, signed by the author, scanned and attached to the online application form

Structured work plan clearly indicating objectives and execution deadlines, written in Portuguese, using the form available on the Services Portal - required for the Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes
Proof of acceptance or enrolment in a Master's/PhD Programme (Research Programme)
Substantiated opinion from the head of the host institution, together with a work plan matching the intended duration type (Fernao Mendes Pinto)

Proof of enrolment in the intended annual or summer course at the selected Portuguese university, which the candidate must complete on the university's own platform before applying (Summer and Annual Course programmes)
Statement of academic record (as listed in the FAQ)
selection_criteria: Priority will be given to candidates whose scholarship is assigned to cooperation protocols or agreements
Bilateral agreements signed by Camoes, I.P. with foreign countries and institutions
Projects arising from Camoes, I.P. training programmes in Portuguese language and culture developed with other Portuguese or foreign institutions

The presence or introduction of Portuguese language and culture programmes in the priority geographical areas of Camoes, I.P. (Ibero-American countries, Eastern Europe, the Maghreb and Southern Africa)
Translation projects under the LATE - Translation and Publishing Support Line (Pessoa and Vieira programmes)
Applications are evaluated by a jury of three members plus substitutes, disclosed in each application opening notice
coverage: A monthly allowance (monthly stipend / monthly subsidy) set by decision of the Board of Directors of Camoes, I.P., paid by bank transfer to the account indicated by the scholarship holder
Payment is made monthly by bank transfer until the 10th day of each month for the duration of the scholarship
Attendance at Portuguese language and culture summer courses, one month, in-person or online (Summer Course Programme)
Attendance at Portuguese language and culture annual courses, eight months, not renewable (Annual Course Programme)
Scientific or professional training projects in the field of Portuguese as a foreign language, renewable up to a maximum of three years (Fernao Mendes Pinto Programme)
Advanced specialisation studies in Portuguese language and culture in Portugal, including Master's and PhD programmes, renewable up to the maximum period established (Research Programme)
Training and research projects in the field of Portuguese language and culture for holders of Portuguese Studies Chairs or Departments, renewable (Pessoa Programme)
Training and/or improvement projects in translation and conference interpreting, renewable (Vieira Programme)
For online Summer Course scholarships only: the course registration/tuition fee
application_method: Complete the application form and upload all supporting documents electronically through the Camoes, I.P. Services Portal at https://portalservicos.instituto-camoes.pt/ (the 2026 online Summer Course used a separate short-link form)
Applications must be submitted between the published opening and closing dates, in 2026 from 5 to 18 May 2026 until 17:00 Lisbon time
Documents must be scanned and sent as PDF, JPEG or PNG; several documents serving the same purpose must be combined into a single compressed file in ZIP, RAR or multi-page PDF format
Documents requested after submission must be sent through the personal area of the Services Portal using the 'New Message' tab
official.application_route: Single electronic submission through the Camoes, I.P. Services Portal (or the programme's short-link form for online summer courses) within the published window; no postal or in-person applications are accepted.
official.citizenship_residency: Programme-specific: the Summer and Annual Course programmes are for foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad; the Fernao Mendes Pinto and Vieira programmes cover foreign graduates and Portuguese nationals residing abroad; the Research Programme is for foreign professors and researchers and Portuguese nationals residing abroad; the Pessoa Programme is for heads of Portuguese Studies Chairs or Portuguese Departments at foreign universities or research institutes.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the calls are explicitly open to foreign nationals and to Portuguese nationals residing abroad; Camoes, I.P. states a policy of non-discrimination and equal access regardless of territory of origin, ancestry, sex, race, language, religion, political or ideological beliefs, education, economic status, social status or sexual orientation.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Portuguese language and culture, Portuguese as a foreign/non-native language, or translation and conference interpreting; the Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes additionally require the project to sit within a Camoes, I.P. Portuguese Language Centre, a Camoes, I.P. Lectureship, or a foreign university or institution holding an agreement with Camoes, I.P.
official.research_requirement: A structured work plan clearly indicating objectives and execution deadlines, written in Portuguese, using the form available on the Services Portal, is mandatory for the Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes; the Research Programme additionally requires proof of acceptance or enrolment in a Master's/PhD Programme and the Fernao Mendes Pinto Programme requires a substantiated opinion from the head of the host institution.
official.duration: Summer Course: one month (in-person or online). Annual Course: eight months, awarded annually and not renewable. Fernao Mendes Pinto: variable, Type 1 (one year), Type 2 (two years) or Type 3 (three years), up to a maximum of three years, renewable. Research: between one month and one year for specialisation courses, two years for Master's Programmes and three years for PhD Programmes, generally awarded annually and renewable. Pessoa: between one and six months, renewable. Vieira: from one month to one year, renewable.
official.description: Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua, I.P., the Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs agency for external language and culture cooperation, operates a set of scholarship programmes within the Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarship Programme, aimed at supporting and promoting the improvement of language skills, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a non-native language, and training and/or improvement in translation and conference interpreting. The programmes are financed by funds from the State Budget allocated to Camoes, I.P./Ministry of Foreign Affairs and, when eligible, by funds made available under the status of Enterprise for the Promotion of the Portuguese Language (EPLP). The scholarship itself is a monthly allowance fixed by decision of the Board of Directors of Camoes, I.P.
official.program_type: Government (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) scholarship programme governed by the Regulation of the Scholarship Program approved by Order no. 1251/2011 of 14 January, financed by State Budget funds allocated to Camoes, I.P. and, when eligible, by EPLP funds

not_confirmed: english_requirement - no IELTS, TOEFL or other English test score, and no medium-of-instruction rule, is published for any of the six programmes; the notices only require that documents and recommendation letters be in Portuguese or English
study_mode - the notices do not label the courses or degrees as full-time or part-time
2027 application dates and 2027 stipend amounts - the 2027 call had not been published when verified; all amounts recorded here are from the 2026 opening notices
funding_amount for the online Summer Course - the notice states only that the scholarship covers the course registration/tuition fee, with no stipend figure
application_period for the online Summer Course route - the 2026 notice used a short-link form rather than the Services Portal, and the route for future rounds is not stated
verification.notes: Amounts, durations, deadlines, document lists and selection criteria were taken from the six official 2026 opening notices published as PDFs on instituto-camoes.pt, cross-checked against the programme's English applications and FAQ pages on the same domain. Every notice states that tuition, registration, travel and accommodation remain the scholarship holder's responsibility, so the catalogue's 'Fully Funded' label is not supported by the official pages. The 2025 English and Portuguese notices were also opened and confirm the same Research (EUR 990) and Annual Course (EUR 875) figures, and a different 2025 application window.

applicant_utility.summary: Camoes, I.P. runs six separate calls under one programme umbrella and you must apply to the right one: Summer Course (one month, online or in-person), Annual Course (eight months, non-renewable), Fernao Mendes Pinto (training projects at Camoes centres and lectureships, up to three years), Research (Master's/PhD in Portugal), Pessoa (for holders of Portuguese Studies Chairs) and Vieira (translation and conference interpreting). The money is a flat monthly allowance only - every 2026 notice states in writing that the grantee pays the university registration fee, tuition, travel and accommodation - so a EUR 990/month Research award is a maintenance stipend, not a funded place. Everything is filed electronically through the Camoes, I.P. Services Portal, only one application per programme is allowed, and any document not in Portuguese or English is disregarded unless it carries a notarised translation.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Teachers, researchers and postgraduate students already tied to Portuguese language and culture work - especially those attached to a Camoes, I.P. centre, lectureship, bilateral agreement or Portuguese Studies Chair, because the jury explicitly gives priority to candidates whose scholarship is linked to a cooperation protocol.
application_readiness_checklist: Enrol first, apply second: the Summer and Annual Course notices require you to enrol at the host university's own platform and attach proof of enrolment to the Camoes application, and that registration fee is yours to pay at that point.
Draft the 100-400 word motivation letter so it names the specific CEFR level or programme you are applying for and ties the award to a concrete career plan in Portuguese language and culture.
Line up two recommenders who teach or work in Portuguese studies; letters carry no official template but must be signed, scanned and written in Portuguese or English.

For Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira, build the structured work plan - objectives plus execution deadlines, in Portuguese, on the form in the Services Portal - and for Research obtain Master's/PhD acceptance or enrolment proof, and for Fernao Mendes Pinto the host institution head's substantiated opinion.
Get every non-Portuguese/English document notarially translated before the window opens, and merge certificates for the same purpose into one ZIP, RAR or multi-page PDF.
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a programme you do not actually belong to - Pessoa is restricted to heads of Portuguese Studies Chairs or Departments, and Fernao Mendes Pinto only covers projects at Camoes, I.P. centres, lectureships or partner institutions.
Missing the proof of university enrolment, which the course calls require up front and which cannot be supplied after submission.
Work plans or recommendation letters in a language other than Portuguese or English, or in English/Portuguese but unsigned and unscanned.
Submitting more than one application to the same programme - the notice cancels all of them, not just the extras.
Motivation letters that omit the level of the course to be attended, which the Summer and Annual Course notices specifically require.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Airfare to and from Portugal, accommodation and living costs beyond the monthly allowance, the university registration fee and tuition, passport, visa and residence formalities, and for online Summer Course holders the equipment and connectivity needed to attend.
document_audit: Unsigned or wrongly-languaged recommendation letters - both alone can make the file non-evaluable.
Proof of academic qualifications must be the actual transcript, and if it is not in Portuguese or English it needs a notarised translation rather than a plain one.

The work plan must be written in Portuguese for Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira, and for Fernao Mendes Pinto it must match the duration type requested (Type 1/2/3 equals one, two or three years).
Motivation letters outside the 100-400 word band are a needless compliance failure; count before you submit.
Translations must be notarised or certified by a recognised authority - a self-made or informal translation is not accepted.
alerts: The application window moves between cycles: most 2025 programmes ran 3 to 18 June 2025, whereas all six 2026 calls ran 5 to 18 May 2026. Never plan around last year's dates.

Holding this scholarship is incompatible with any other scholarship of the same nature granted by another Portuguese institution, so choose carefully if you also hold or are offered a Portuguese institutional award.
Renewals are subject to the Board of Directors and to available budget, so a multi-year Research or Fernao Mendes Pinto grant is not guaranteed to run its full stated term.

Provisional lists appear within 30 working days of the deadline and you then have only 10 working days to submit arguments or missing documents, so watch the Portal personal area and the Messages tab rather than a single email inbox.
The stipend is set by Board decision and changes between cycles - the figure in the previous year's notice is not a promise about the next.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: File everything electronically in the Camoes, I.P. Services Portal during the published window, after which the jury publishes provisional results within 30 working days, candidates get 10 working days to be heard, and a definitive ranking is approved by the President of Camoes, I.P.
